personal.name: Trupal Patel
personal.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
personal.storyText:
I am a true all round Software Engineer. I don't box myself into just frontend or backend, and I'm not tied to a single programming language. I thrive on handling the entire software lifecycle, from architecting intricate backend logic and designing seamless user interfaces, all the way to deploying highly scalable production ready systems.

Most recently, as the Founding Software Engineer at Allyvia, I had the opportunity to build a comprehensive SaaS platform from the ground up, touching every part of the stack on GCP, from React 19 UI design and Django REST APIs to BigQuery analytics pipelines and Pub/Sub event-driven ingestion. Before that, at AIVID.AI, I engineered high performance analytics pipelines and optimized Elasticsearch queries for over 200 production sites to ensure everything ran fast and reliably at scale.

Beyond corporate roles, I love building robust systems like StoreDesk, a production grade 5 module retail command center and POS ecosystem I architected from scratch. It seamlessly connects local edge nodes to cloud dashboards and mobile apps via WebSockets, completely eliminating downtime risks for convenience stores. For me, it is all about deeply understanding a problem, designing a scalable architecture, and writing clean code that actually makes a difference.
personal.voiceSummary: Hi, I'm Trupal Patel. I am a true all round Software Engineer. I don't box myself into just frontend or backend roles, and I'm not tied to a single language. I handle the entire software lifecycle, from architecting intricate backend logic and designing seamless user interfaces, all the way to deploying highly scalable production ready systems. Most recently, as the Founding Software Engineer at Allyvia, I built a comprehensive SaaS platform from the ground up, touching every part of the stack on Google Cloud, from React UI design and Python REST APIs to BigQuery analytics pipelines and event driven Pub/Sub ingestion. Before that, at AIVID.AI, I engineered high performance analytics pipelines and optimized Elasticsearch queries for over two hundred production sites. Beyond corporate roles, I also architected StoreDesk, a production grade five module retail command center and POS ecosystem from scratch to eliminate downtime risks for convenience stores. For me, it is all about deeply understanding a problem, designing a scalable architecture, and writing clean code that makes a real impact. I would love to bring this exact same drive and architectural vision to your team. Feel free to connect with me on the socials page or download my resume to get in touch!

achievements: Architected a cloud-native, full-stack SaaS platform on GCP using Python, React 19, TypeScript, and Django REST Framework.

Engineered BigQuery-based analytics and data processing pipelines that sync QuickBooks accounting data, using incremental loads and Python-based transformations to keep API response latency under 200ms.

Built secure multi-tenant workflows including PIN-authorized kiosk clock-in/out consoles, RBAC route guarding, and OAuth token refresh cycles, owning design, development, testing, and production support.
Developed AI-enabled REST APIs and integrations, using GCP Cloud Storage and Pub/Sub for event-driven ingestion in an emerging GenAI prototype assistant.
Developed a CRM Hub with leads tracking, deals pipelines, tasks, and call notes, linked to client documents and financial invoices.
Built an Inventory Synchronization module mapping QuickBooks items to local stock, with reorder points, stock-on-hand tracking, and PostgreSQL trigram similarity search.
Designed a multi-module reporting and analytics engine covering Finance, Inventory, CRM, and Employee shifts, served from BigQuery aggregates.

deepDive.systemOverview: Cloud-native enterprise workflow, financial management, and CRM platform on Google Cloud, built with React 19, TypeScript, Material UI, Python, Django REST Framework, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Storage. Featuring incremental QuickBooks Online sync into BigQuery, event-driven ingestion, CRM pipeline management, employee shift tracking, multi-module reports and analytics, and a GenAI prototype assistant.
deepDive.responsibilities: Led the end-to-end full-stack development of the SaaS platform on GCP. Designed the frontend state management (Redux Toolkit, React Query) and scalable Django REST API endpoints. Built the BigQuery data pipelines for QuickBooks sync and analytics, the Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage event-driven ingestion layer, AI-enabled REST APIs for the GenAI prototype assistant, third-party OAuth integrations, and dynamic role-based access control (RBAC).
challenges: Keeping QuickBooks Online accounting data consistent in the platform while staying within API rate limits and avoiding request timeouts.
Serving multi-module business intelligence metrics (utilization rates, conversion funnels, cash flows) fast, without heavy queries on every page load.
Securing sensitive customer credentials and managing automated token refresh cycles for QuickBooks and Google OAuth flows.
Ingesting uploaded documents and webhook events reliably without blocking the main HTTP request thread.
Designing a reliable, stateful clock-in/out console (Kiosk) to manage employee time tracking and shift durations securely.
Handling fuzzy search across large inventory, contact, and transaction tables efficiently.
solutions: Built incremental-load pipelines that pull only QuickBooks changes since the last recorded sync, transform them in Python, and land them in BigQuery.
Pre-aggregated reporting metrics in BigQuery and cached results so the Finance, Inventory, CRM, Employee, and Overview pages load from ready aggregates.
Stored access and refresh tokens with symmetric database-level encryption, alongside automated background refresh checks.
Published upload and webhook events to Pub/Sub with files in Cloud Storage, processed asynchronously by background workers that also feed the GenAI prototype assistant.
Implemented a PIN-authorized Kiosk dashboard with session locking to manage employee shifts and clock-in/out time logs.
Used PostgreSQL TrigramSimilarity for fast fuzzy matching on names, SKUs, and descriptions.
impact: Kept API response latency under 200ms, including every reports page, by serving analytics from BigQuery aggregates.
Synchronized 10 critical accounting entities (Invoices, Bills, Inventory Items, Payments, etc.) between Allyvia and QuickBooks Online, ensuring ledger consistency.
Moved document and webhook ingestion onto event-driven Pub/Sub workers, keeping the web tier responsive.
Shipped AI-enabled REST APIs powering an early GenAI prototype assistant.
Encrypted third-party OAuth tokens across all company profiles, preventing credential leakage.
Delivered RBAC route guarding, dynamic menu filtering, and UI action permissions based on subscription tiers and user roles.
Provisioned a secure physical kiosk station for zero-friction clock-in/out and automated shift durations.
Enabled full client pipeline management (leads, deals, and notes) linked to company documents and financial invoices.

achievements: Deployed analytics pipelines and device management portals across 200+ enterprise production sites using Angular, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python.
Improved large-scale Elasticsearch query retrieval speeds by ~25% through structural index mapping and aggregation optimizations.
Maintained 99% stream uptime across edge camera systems via a custom C# Windows service manager with multi-ISP dynamic failover.
Cut fraudulent customer return claims by 90% by deploying barcode-triggered C# / EmguCV video capture bots.
Designed automated background workers and scheduled reporting workflows on top of Oracle database architectures.

deepDive.systemOverview: Enterprise-scale edge computer vision and analytics platform operating across 200+ deployment sites, utilizing Angular, Node.js, React, and Python, alongside localized IoT devices and C# Windows services.
deepDive.responsibilities: Engineered multi-site operations management portals, custom Kibana analytics plugins (React, EUI, ApexCharts), and automated edge video capture bots (C#, EmguCV). Optimized large-scale Elasticsearch data pipelines and built local Python/Docker IoT gate controllers.
challenges: Visualizing and querying high-velocity streaming computer vision event logs efficiently across billions of records.
Maintaining reliable, continuous RTSP stream capture from on-premise ONVIF cameras with intermittent internet connections.
Reducing false claims on shipping returns without introducing manual oversight delays.
Creating a resilient system to execute scheduled tasks, metric digests, and alert deliveries without blocking primary application threads.
solutions: Optimized Elasticsearch document mappings and query DSLs, accelerating retrieval by ~25%.
Developed a robust C# WinForms application with NSSM background services to handle stream forwarding and dynamic multi-ISP failover.
Built an automated C# and EmguCV tool featuring barcode-triggered recording (scan-to-start / scan-to-stop) and local rolling disk retention.
Engineered a decoupled Node.js cron scheduling engine to handle background jobs like email alerts and live Google Sheets data injections.

Engineered containerized Python edge daemons in Docker interfacing over serial connections with Arduino microcontrollers and camera feeds, paired with a lightweight Next.js operator UI for local access gate overrides.
impact: Successfully managed bot configurations and device health telemetry across 200+ enterprise production sites.
Engineered 45+ customizable dashboards for enterprise analytics visualization.
Maintained 99% stream uptime despite unpredictable edge network conditions.
Reduced fraudulent shipping return claims by 90% via automated scan-to-start video verification.
Seamlessly connected serial Arduino microcontrollers with containerized Python edge daemons for local gate access control.
